content.value_statement: Financial statements can hide important performance, liquidity, leverage, and valuation signals. This skill calculates key ratios and explains results using benchmarks and trends.
actual_capabilities: Calculates profitability ratios including return on equity, return on assets, and operating margins.
Calculates liquidity, leverage, efficiency, and valuation ratios from supplied statement values.
Compares selected ratios with general or sector benchmarks for five supported industries.
Analyzes ratio changes across multiple periods and labels trends as stable, improving, or deteriorating.
Generates a financial health assessment, formatted report, and prioritized recommendations.
limitations: Results depend on complete, accurate, and consistently defined financial inputs.
The included Python modules accept structured values but do not directly parse CSV, Excel, or filing documents.
Benchmarks are simplified guidelines for technology, retail, financial, manufacturing, healthcare, or general contexts.
The analysis is not investment advice and does not predict future performance.

use_cases.title: Screen a Potential Investment
use_cases.description: Calculate valuation, profitability, leverage, and liquidity measures before deeper company research.

use_cases.title: Review Borrower Health
use_cases.description: Assess debt coverage, working capital, and financial trends using supplied statements.

use_cases.title: Track Operating Performance
use_cases.description: Compare margins, returns, and turnover ratios across reporting periods.

prompt_templates.title: Calculate One Ratio
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate the current ratio using current assets of [amount] and current liabilities of [amount]. Explain the result briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Financial Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these income statement and balance sheet values: [values]. Calculate the most relevant ratios and identify missing inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Period Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these ratios across [periods]: [values]. Identify improving, stable, and deteriorating trends, then explain the main drivers.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Industry Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a comprehensive ratio analysis for a [industry] company using [financial data]. Compare benchmarks, assess overall health, and prioritize recommendations.

output_examples.input: Current assets are $800,000 and current liabilities are $400,000.
output_examples.output: Current ratio: 2.00. This indicates strong short-term liquidity under the general benchmark.

output_examples.input: Net income is $150,000 and shareholders' equity is $1,500,000.
output_examples.output: Return on equity: 10.0%. This meets the general acceptable threshold but remains below the good benchmark.

output_examples.input: Debt-to-equity moved from 1.20 to 0.80 over three annual periods.
output_examples.output: Trend: Improving. Leverage declined by 33.3%, indicating lower debt relative to shareholders' equity.

best_practices: Reconcile inputs to the same reporting period and currency before calculating ratios.
Provide industry context and at least two periods when requesting benchmark or trend analysis.
Review source statements and calculation assumptions before using results in decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not replace missing values with industry averages without clearly labeling the assumption.
Do not compare companies using inconsistent accounting periods, currencies, or ratio definitions.
Do not treat a single ratio or benchmark rating as a complete investment conclusion.

faq.question: Which ratios can this skill calculate?
faq.answer: It covers profitability, liquidity, leverage, efficiency, valuation, and selected per-share metrics.

faq.question: Which financial data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide relevant income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, market, and historical values with clear periods and units.

faq.question: Can it analyze several reporting periods?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide ratio values and matching period labels to receive direction, percentage change, and trend commentary.

faq.question: Does it support industry comparisons?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes simplified benchmarks for technology, retail, financial, manufacturing, healthcare, and general analysis.

faq.question: Can the scripts read Excel or CSV files directly?
faq.answer: No. The included modules expect structured financial values, so file contents must be extracted before calculation.

faq.question: Does this skill provide investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides calculation and interpretation support, but users must verify data and make independent decisions.
